global_style.art_style: Clean 2D cartoon illustration, indie webcomic art style, thin black line art, soft neutral-toned flat watercolor wash fills, minimalist background, storybook animation frame. Simple, modern digital drawing, flat design. Serious documentary storytelling atmosphere, expressive characters, muted industrial colors, carefully composed cinematic frames. Every frame should have a distinct composition, varied camera angles, dynamic character poses, layered foreground, midground and background, and environmental details that make the power plant feel like a real working industrial facility. Use restrained visual storytelling for the accident, focusing on the environment, danger and human emotion rather than graphic injury.
global_style.negative_prompt: photorealism, 3d render, glossy digital painting, neon colors, exaggerated horror, graphic gore, exposed flesh, graphic burns, dismemberment, excessive flames covering the entire frame, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, inconsistent character appearance, blurry image, low resolution, watermark, logo, readable text

antonio.label: Antonio Navarrete
antonio.visual_dna: A 21-year-old Hispanic-American male industrial maintenance worker, average height and lean build, youthful face, short dark brown hair, clean-shaven, expressive brown eyes. Wearing a dark navy-blue industrial work uniform, matching work trousers, sturdy dark safety boots, protective gloves and a white hard hat. His clothes look like ordinary workwear, not futuristic protective armor. Keep his face, hairstyle, uniform and proportions consistent in every appearance.

maintenance_workers.label: Maintenance Crew
maintenance_workers.visual_dna: A group of four adult male industrial maintenance workers, each with distinct facial features and body types. They wear practical navy-blue work uniforms, safety boots, protective gloves and white hard hats. Their expressions and body language should feel natural and focused on a difficult maintenance task. Keep the group visually consistent throughout the story.

plant_supervisor.label: Plant Supervisor
plant_supervisor.visual_dna: An adult male power plant supervisor in his late forties, medium build, short greying hair, clean-shaven face, wearing a light blue collared work shirt, dark trousers, safety glasses and a white hard hat. Carries a clipboard and has a serious, businesslike expression. Maintain the same appearance throughout.

antonio_mother.label: Antonio's Mother
antonio_mother.visual_dna: A middle-aged Hispanic-American woman with warm brown eyes, medium-length dark brown hair with a few grey strands, wearing a simple muted burgundy cardigan over a light blouse. Her expressions should feel natural and emotionally restrained. Keep her appearance consistent in the brief phone-call sequence.

power_plant.label: Tampa Power Plant
power_plant.visual_dna: A large industrial power plant in Tampa, Florida, with enormous steel boiler structures, thick pipes, metal walkways, railings, maintenance platforms, industrial staircases, overhead beams and tall smokestacks. The interior is dominated by dark steel, dusty concrete, muted yellow safety markings and heavy machinery. Include realistic industrial details such as warning lights, pressure gauges, pipes and control panels, but no readable company logos or signage.

boiler_chamber.label: Boiler and Slag Chamber
boiler_chamber.visual_dna: A massive industrial boiler chamber with thick steel walls, heavy pipes, a lower discharge channel and a water-cooling collection area designed to receive hot industrial slag. The chamber has metal access platforms, maintenance ladders, railings and a narrow service area. A dangerous accumulation of glowing orange molten slag can build up above the lower maintenance area. Preserve the industrial layout and recognizable machinery across shots.

control_room.label: Power Plant Control Room
control_room.visual_dna: A practical industrial control room with rows of analogue gauges, indicator lights, control switches, monitoring screens, a large process diagram and a long console desk. Cool fluorescent lighting, muted grey walls and a large observation window looking toward industrial equipment. Screens may show abstract diagrams and indicators but must contain no readable text.

smartphone.label: Smartphone
smartphone.visual_dna: A simple black smartphone with a slightly worn protective case, dark glass screen and rounded corners. It should look like an ordinary personal phone, not a futuristic device. Keep its appearance consistent.

beats.narration_text: Antonio Navarrete सिर्फ 21 साल का था। Tampa के एक power plant में उसकी नई नौकरी लगी थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio} standing at the entrance of {assets.power_plant}, wearing his navy-blue maintenance uniform and white hard hat. He looks toward the enormous industrial structure with a mixture of nervousness and excitement. Towering steel pipes, smokestacks, metal walkways and overhead structures fill the background. A security gate and industrial safety railings frame the foreground. Use a low wide-angle composition to make the facility feel enormous compared with the young worker.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the exterior of a large Tampa power plant in daylight. Introduce Antonio with his exact visual design and establish the industrial scale, steel structures, pipes and walkways.

beats.narration_text: उसकी wife pregnant थी। वह हर महीने की salary से अपने परिवार के लिए एक घर खरीदने का सपना देख रहा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio} taking a short break near an industrial window, looking at a small personal photograph tucked inside his work locker. The photograph shows him standing beside his pregnant wife, without requiring detailed facial identity. His expression is gentle and hopeful. His safety helmet rests on the locker shelf, while pipes and steel equipment are visible through the window behind him. Use a warm close composition that contrasts his personal dream with the cold industrial workplace.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain within the same power plant facility. Preserve Antonio's exact appearance and work uniform; introduce a personal locker and a small family photograph to communicate his hopes.

beats.narration_text: वह सिर्फ 12 dollars per hour कमाता था… और यह उसकी job का चौथा दिन था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio} tightening his protective gloves and adjusting his white hard hat before starting work. His work boots stand on a dusty metal floor, with a maintenance tool bag beside him. Behind him, the industrial corridor stretches toward a huge boiler chamber. Use a close, low-angle composition focused on his hands and work gear, with his determined face visible in the upper part of the frame.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep Antonio inside the same power plant. Preserve his workwear and facial features; show him preparing for a maintenance shift in a new close-up composition.

beats.narration_text: उस दिन boiler के अंदर molten slag जमा हो रहा था। यह lava जैसा बेहद गर्म material था।
beats.prompt_action: Show the enormous interior of {assets.boiler_chamber}. High above the lower service area, a growing mass of glowing orange molten slag is accumulating behind an industrial blockage. Thick steel pipes, structural beams and maintenance platforms surround the chamber. A faint orange glow reflects off the metal surfaces, while a small amount of steam drifts through the air. Use a dramatic vertical composition that shows the dangerous height and scale of the machinery.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the boiler chamber with its heavy steel structure, lower discharge channel, cooling collection area and elevated slag accumulation. Use restrained orange light to communicate extreme heat without graphic imagery.

beats.narration_text: इसे cool करने के लिए नीचे एक water tank था… लेकिन रास्ता blockage की वजह से बंद था।
beats.prompt_action: Show the lower section of {assets.boiler_chamber}, focusing on the blocked discharge channel leading toward the water-cooling tank. A dense industrial obstruction is visible inside the channel. The tank sits below, separated from the accumulated molten material by the blocked passage. Metal railings, pipes, warning lights and a maintenance ladder create layers around the frame. Use a high-angle view that clearly communicates the blocked route.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain inside the same boiler chamber. Preserve the machinery layout and show the blocked discharge route and water-cooling tank from a different camera position.

beats.narration_text: Plant को बंद करने के बजाय, management ने पाँच workers को blockage हटाने भेज दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.plant_supervisor} standing on a metal maintenance platform, pointing toward the blocked section of {assets.boiler_chamber}. {assets.antonio} and {assets.maintenance_workers} listen to the instructions while holding maintenance tools. The supervisor holds a clipboard. Huge pipes and the boiler structure loom behind them. Compose the shot from slightly below eye level, with the supervisor in the foreground and all five workers clearly visible in the middle ground.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the same boiler chamber and industrial platform. Introduce the supervisor and the five-person maintenance crew, preserving Antonio's distinct appearance and the crew's consistent work uniforms.

beats.narration_text: Machine चलती रही… और workers को अंदाज़ा भी नहीं था कि उनके ठीक ऊपर क्या जमा हो रहा है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio} and {assets.maintenance_workers} working near the lower blocked channel. They use industrial tools to inspect the obstruction, focused entirely on their task. Above them, the enormous steel chamber disappears into darkness, with an ominous orange glow visible behind upper metal supports. Use a dramatic low-angle perspective from near the workers' boots, emphasizing the unseen danger directly overhead.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain in the same boiler chamber. Preserve the five workers and machinery positions; change the camera angle to reveal the growing danger above them while they continue working.

beats.narration_text: फिर आखिरकार… blockage हट गया।
beats.prompt_action: Same maintenance area. Show {assets.antonio} and one of {assets.maintenance_workers} completing the final movement with their tools as the obstruction shifts out of the discharge channel. A sudden vibration runs through the nearby metal structure. Fine dust and tiny particles fall from above. The workers begin to look upward in confusion.
beats.session_delta_prompt: In the same scene: keep the five workers, boiler chamber, tools and industrial layout identical. Change only the action to show the blockage being cleared and the workers beginning to react to the vibration.

beats.narration_text: और अगले ही पल, हजारों pounds molten slag नीचे गिरने लगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show a massive stream of glowing orange molten slag suddenly pouring from the elevated discharge area inside {assets.boiler_chamber}. The intense flow spreads across the lower industrial floor, illuminating the metal platforms, pipes and railings with a fierce orange glow. The five maintenance workers appear as small silhouettes at a safe visual distance from the main flow, reacting in alarm. Use a wide diagonal composition to communicate the scale and suddenness of the industrial disaster. Do not depict graphic injuries.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Continue in the same boiler chamber but show the sudden molten slag release. Preserve the machinery layout and the five workers; focus on the scale of the dangerous flow and the dramatic change in lighting.

beats.narration_text: वह 40 feet तक फैल गया… और लगभग आधा foot मोटी परत बन गई।
beats.prompt_action: Show the lower floor of {assets.boiler_chamber} from a high industrial platform. A broad glowing orange layer of molten slag spreads across a large section of the floor, reaching toward metal supports and maintenance equipment. Steam rises in thick white clouds, and the intense light reflects off nearby steel surfaces. The long industrial walkway provides a visual sense of distance. Use a wide overhead composition to communicate how much of the floor has been covered.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain in the same boiler chamber after the release. Preserve the industrial structure and show the molten material spread across the lower floor with rising steam and intense reflected light.

beats.narration_text: वहाँ मौजूद पाँचों workers इस हादसे की चपेट में आ गए।
beats.prompt_action: Same boiler chamber during the accident. Show the five maintenance workers struggling to move away from the spreading molten flow, partially obscured by dense steam and strong orange backlighting. {assets.antonio} is visible among them, his white hard hat and navy uniform recognizable through the haze. Keep the framing distant and non-graphic, using silhouettes, steam and the industrial environment to convey danger.
beats.session_delta_prompt: In the same scene: preserve the boiler chamber, molten flow and five workers. Change only their body positions to show an urgent attempt to escape. Keep the depiction non-graphic and avoid visible injuries.

beats.narration_text: Antonio ने किसी तरह अपना phone निकाला… और अपनी माँ को call किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio} in a smoke-filled industrial area, holding {assets.smartphone} close to his face with a trembling gloved hand. His expression is frightened and desperate. Orange light flickers across the background, while thick steam partially obscures the steel machinery. Frame the phone and his face in a tight emotional composition, with no graphic depiction of injury.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Stay within the same accident environment. Preserve Antonio's appearance and uniform; shift to a close-up showing him desperately trying to make a phone call through the steam and confusion.

beats.narration_text: Call माँ ने नहीं उठाया… voicemail शुरू हो गया।
beats.prompt_action: Same accident setting. Show {assets.smartphone} in Antonio's trembling hand, its screen displaying a generic incoming voicemail recording interface with abstract icons and no readable text. His other gloved hand is visible near the edge of the frame. The background is softly blurred with pale steam and faint orange industrial light.
beats.session_delta_prompt: In the same scene: keep the smartphone, Antonio's hand and smoky industrial background identical. Change only the phone screen to indicate that the call has reached voicemail, without adding readable text.

beats.narration_text: उस voicemail में उसकी आखिरी recorded आवाज़ थी… 'Mom! Help me! I'm burning! Call the cops! Mom!'
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio} holding {assets.smartphone} close to his mouth, desperately calling for help. His eyes are wide with fear, and his expression is strained. Dense steam fills the background, with distant orange light reflecting from industrial steel. Keep the image focused on his face and the phone, using a restrained non-graphic depiction. No subtitles or visible words.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Continue the same accident moment. Preserve Antonio's face, work uniform and smartphone; focus on the emotional urgency of his final recorded message without showing graphic injuries.

beats.narration_text: उसकी माँ तक सिर्फ उसकी चीखें नहीं… पीछे आती steam की आवाज़ भी पहुँची।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.antonio_mother} at home in a modest living room, holding a phone near her ear. Her expression changes from ordinary attention to sudden fear and confusion. A simple sofa, a small table and a warm household lamp create a quiet domestic setting. The contrast between the peaceful home and the distressing call should be clear. Keep the phone screen without readable text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Antonio's mother in a separate quiet home environment. Preserve her established appearance and clothing; show her listening to the voicemail with growing alarm.

beats.narration_text: Antonio की आवाज़ voicemail में दर्ज हो गई… लेकिन वह तुरंत नहीं मरा।
beats.prompt_action: Show a quiet hospital corridor with a closed intensive care unit door, muted hospital lighting, empty chairs and a wall clock. A medical staff member walks past in the background. The scene should feel serious and respectful, without showing a patient or medical procedure. Use a long perspective down the corridor to create a sense of waiting and uncertainty.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Transition from the power plant to a hospital corridor. Establish a quiet, serious atmosphere with an intensive care unit entrance and restrained documentary-style visual storytelling.

beats.narration_text: वह पाँच दिनों तक coma में रहा… उसके शरीर पर 80 percent burns थे।
beats.prompt_action: Show a respectful, non-graphic view of an intensive care room through a partially open doorway. A hospital bed is visible with a patient mostly covered by clean white sheets, surrounded by medical monitoring equipment. A family member sits quietly nearby with their hands clasped. Keep the patient unidentifiable and do not show injuries, exposed skin or graphic medical details. Use soft neutral hospital lighting and a still, solemn composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the hospital intensive care setting several days after the accident. Keep the scene non-graphic and respectful; communicate the seriousness through the hospital equipment and the waiting family member.

beats.narration_text: पाँच दिन बाद Antonio की मौत हो गई। उसके साथ चार और workers भी इस हादसे में मारे गए।
beats.prompt_action: Show five simple white flowers placed beside five small work helmets on a quiet table outside the hospital. One helmet is slightly smaller in visual presence, suggesting the youngest worker without using labels. In the background, a softly blurred family member stands in silence near a window. Use a restrained, respectful composition with muted colors and gentle daylight. No readable names or signage.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create a quiet memorial scene after the accident. Use five work helmets and five white flowers to represent the five workers who died. Keep the visual treatment respectful and understated.

beats.narration_text: इस हादसे को रोका जा सकता था… अगर maintenance के दौरान machine बंद कर दी जाती।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.control_room} with its long console, process diagrams, analogue gauges and industrial monitoring screens. An empty operator chair faces the control panel. A large observation window reveals the power plant structures outside. The control switches and indicator lights create a quiet but unsettling atmosphere. Use a symmetrical wide composition that emphasizes the machinery and the absence of a person at the controls.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the power plant control room with its industrial consoles, gauges, screens and observation window. Use a restrained, documentary-like composition.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि उस दिन काम तो पाँच लोगों ने किया था… लेकिन machine बंद करने का फैसला उनके हाथ में नहीं था।
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of the industrial control console in {assets.control_room}, with several illuminated indicator lights, heavy switches and a large emergency shutdown control clearly visible. In the blurred background, the supervisor stands near the console looking toward the plant observation window. Use a slightly tilted composition to create tension. Do not show readable labels or company branding.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain inside the same control room. Preserve its console, screens and observation window; shift to a close-up of the control switches and the supervisor in the background.

beats.narration_text: अब आप बताइए… क्या पैसे बचाने के लिए चलती machine के नीचे workers को भेजना सही फैसला था?
beats.prompt_action: Show the enormous exterior of {assets.power_plant} at dusk, with its towering smokestacks, steel structures, pipes and industrial walkways silhouetted against a muted evening sky. In the foreground, five empty white hard hats rest on a low concrete ledge. A quiet service road leads toward the plant entrance. Use a wide, still composition with the helmets sharply visible and the power plant dominating the distant background. End on a serious, thought-provoking frame.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create the final exterior view of the same power plant at dusk. Preserve its industrial identity and use five empty work helmets in the foreground as a restrained visual reminder of the workers.
